title: Legal / regulatory genre profile (Layer 2 — functional roles)
description: Functional-role vocabulary for LEGAL and REGULATORY documents (Code of Federal Regulations, Federal Register notices, court opinions). A role is an OPTIONAL second label on a layer-1 block; each role declares the layer-1 kind(s) it may attach to. Publisher/agency-specific marker strings (e.g. Federal Register field labels) that TRIGGER these roles live ONLY in Layer-3 lexicons (federal_register_lexicon.json) — never here.
$comment: Grounds the align_gold generic-tag fallback for cfr / federal_register / courtlistener into named functional roles. Consistency: every role.attaches_to is non-empty.

x-roles.label: Section number
x-roles.description: A regulatory / statutory section designator (e.g. a CFR section number) heading a provision.

x-roles.label: Citation
x-roles.description: A legal citation / cross-reference to another authority, section, or docket.

x-roles.label: Enacting / summary clause
x-roles.description: The enacting language or a rule summary (the operative regulatory statement of a provision or notice).

x-roles.label: Agency header
x-roles.description: The issuing-agency masthead / header line of a Federal Register document.

x-roles.label: Docket / metadata line
x-roles.description: A structured metadata line (action, dates, docket number, contact) in a regulatory notice.

x-roles.label: Holding
x-roles.description: The court's holding / disposition in an opinion.

x-roles.label: Syllabus / headnote
x-roles.description: The reporter's syllabus / headnote summarizing a court opinion.
